Simple Inventory 1.0 (MZ)
reflector88
​
What is it?
This plugin removes item categories (weapons, armor, etc.) from the inventory scene and enables customization options, like changing the size and position of the window.
What is this for?
Good for simple projects like horror or story-driven games that don't require item categories.
Screenshots
How to Use
1. Put the .js file in your project's js/plugins/ folder.
2. In RMMZ, open the Plugin Manager through the Toolbar.
3. Double click an empty line, then use the "Name:" box to select "r88_SimpleInventory".
Link
Download on Itch.io
Terms and Credits
Free for commercial and non-commercial projects. Credit me if you found it helpful.

Hey, thanks for reporting the issue. I've tested the plugin with a blank project, and it seems to be working from my end.
From the error message, it looks like the program can't parse the input from the "Hide Item Icon" or "Hide Item Name" parameters. I would try the following:
1. Go to the Plugin Settings.
2. Check if the values for "Hide Item Icon" and "Hide Item Name" say exactly the text "true" or "false" (without quotes, spaces, etc.)
If that doesn't work, try resetting the plugin settings by deleting it from the Plugin Manager. Also, you might try testing with a blank project to rule out a compatibility issue.
